title: Compliance Onboarding Accelerator + SLA Pilot
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Run a customer-facing pilot that bundles an accelerated compliance onboarding flow (auto-filled security questionnaire + mapped evidence artifacts) with an optional paid Premium SLA and extended observability retention add-on. Goal: validate willingness to pay for turnkey compliance acceleration and measure conversion uplift vs standard onboarding.
goals: Measure conversion rate lift for enterprise customers using the Onboarding Accelerator vs baseline
Quantify incremental ARR from Premium SLA attachment at onboarding
Validate operational cost of extended retention per tenant and refine per-GB pricing guardrails
Confirm security questionnaire auto-fill reduces time-to-purchase and support tickets
acceptance_criteria: Pilot enabled for 6 qualified customers across finance and healthcare segments
Automatic security questionnaire population works for 80% of required fields for supported templates (SOC2, ISO27001, HIPAA) without manual edits
SLA opt-in rate >= 20% across pilot customers or clear rejection reasons documented
Telemetry shows observability retention usage and incremental storage cost per tenant within forecasted 15% variance
milestones: 2026-02-28: Finalize PRD and pricing bands for retention add-on
2026-03-07: Engineering spike complete for questionnaire auto-fill endpoints (ENG-39110)
2026-03-14: Begin pilot onboarding of first two customers
2026-03-28: Mid-pilot check-in, preliminary pricing & UX changes
notes: We will offer a 60-day trial of the observability retention add-on during the pilot and capture usage to inform permanent pricing bands. Questionnaire auto-fill will use existing tenancy metadata and prior contract artifacts; scope is intentionally narrow for first release (SOC2 core controls + network architecture).
risks: Auto-fill errors could surface PII in attachments if mappings aren't validated
High variability in retention usage could make per-customer pricing noisy
Legal sign-off for SLA language may delay shipping to some customers
decisions: Keep pricing linear per-GB with a stepped discount after 10TB for pilot customers
Expose SLA as an opt-in checkbox during onboarding rather than buried in contract addenda
Limit questionnaire auto-fill to metadata-backed fields; do not auto-attach customer documents in pilot
